page.overview:
Who is Skinner?

Skinner was a member of the species. Unlike most Yautja, Skinner had no honor and belonged to no clan, mercilessly slaughtering any creature he encountered and taking body parts as trophies. Due to his numerous violations of the Yautja Honor Code that disgraces his entire species, Yautja hunting groups were dispatched to kill him.

Skinner began killing the people and creatures of New York City without restraint during a heat wave, drawing attention from both NYPD detective LaPearl, Daily Bugle Editor–in–Chief J. Jonah Jameson, and the city's resident superhero, Spider-Man. Lurking in the underground depths of the city and donning human skin as masks to fool humans (along with the Yautja's ability to mimic human voices), he came dangerously close to killing Spider-Man's girlfriend, Mary Jane Watson. Skinner was ultimately killed by Kraven the Hunter, whom the Yautja allowed to be integrated into their ranks after seeing his worth as a ruthless hunter. Kraven would then spearhead an all–out Yautja invasion of Earth alongside the Predator King's eldest son Graveyard, targeting all of Earth's heroes.
